description: This file is a Bash script that defines functions for managing git worktrees related to pull requests, including functions to navigate the repository root, fetch PR metadata, write metadata files, list PR worktrees, and clean up old worktrees. It provides automation for handling GitHub pull requests within a development environment.

methods.name: repo_root
methods.description: Determines the canonical root directory of the Git repository, resolving via git common-dir or falling back to parent directory.

methods.name: enter_worktree
methods.description: Switches to a specific pull request worktree, optionally resetting it to main.

methods.name: pr_meta_json
methods.description: Fetches detailed metadata of a pull request from GitHub in JSON format.

methods.name: write_pr_meta_files
methods.description: Writes PR metadata to a JSON file and exports specific info as shell environment variables.

methods.name: list_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Lists all existing PR worktrees with some details fetched from GitHub.

methods.name: gc_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Deletes (or simulates deletion in dry run) of merged or closed PR worktrees to clean up the local environment.

methods.name: pr_number_from_worktree_dir
methods.description: Extracts the PR number from a given worktree directory name.
